events.summary: Hey everyone!The closed playtest is over, and the Demo is live right now for everyone. You don't need to request access or wait for a wave. Just hit Download Demo on the store page and start putting toys away.A big thank you to everyone who joined the playtest. You played, you broke things and you told us what felt off, and the game is better because of it.
